## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后的行为

Describe the concrete trigger, what happens today, and what this change makes happen.
Link the related issue if there is one. 中文或英文均可。

## Validation / 验证

List the commands you actually ran and their results. Explain anything you could not verify.

- [ ] Relevant regression checks pass (include MCP checks when changing that entry point).
- [ ] Documentation and examples reflect changed public behavior.
- [ ] Protocol, database, or configuration compatibility changes are documented when applicable.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures contain no credentials, private task content, or user databases.

## Compatibility and limitations / 兼容性与限制

Note migration needs, remaining limitations, or review considerations. Remove this section if it is not relevant.
